title: Non-record: BigramHash uppercase enrichment (1xH100, val_bpb 1.3132)
author: FelixFuhs

data.description: Adds a learned hashed local-memory table using previous and current token ids, injected into the transformer.
Tokenizer-derived hash-address enrichment using an uppercase flag in the hash key.

novel_contributions: Uppercase hash enrichment improved BigramHash performance
Demonstrated that simple tokenizer-derived hash enrichment outperformed more complex variants
Documented a non-record single-seed run with full reproduction artifacts
